findings.evidence: The original parser uses generic timestamp before createdAt and substitutes utc_now for absent/invalid clocks. Boolean, micro/nanosecond and future clocks can produce invalid or fabricated zero-age births. Initial PumpPortal integrity suite has19 failures and2 passes.

Preserve absent/invalid/future birth as unknown, original explicit invalid alias ownership and normalized positive finite numeric epoch units. Accept Python/NumPy real numeric scalars but reject booleans, complex values and containers.
